3. Heard the learned counsel for the applicants as well as the learned APP for the State.
4. Perusal of the case-dairy reveals that complainant- Vaishali Kodhe lodged a complaint alleging that the applicants along with the other co-accused induced her to deposit an amount of Rs.2.5 crores in return of which she will get Rs.1.5 crores profit within 2 days, which RR Jaiswal 2 48-aba-965-25.odt will be deposited in her account and remaining Rs.1 crores will be returned to her in four months.
Thereafter, she will get Rs.20 lakhs per month for a period of three years as Royalty.
Therefore, she invested an amount of Rs.1,48,00,000/- by taking a loan of Rs.1.5 crores on her agricultural field.

The First Information Report (FIR) further depicts that applicant no. 1- Sanjay Gade is a driver by profession and applicant no. 2- Yogesh Bhalerao appears to be an associate of main accused- Rajendra Upadhayay.

The learned counsel for the applicants vehemently submitted that the applicants have not played any role; rather, the main accused- Rajendra Upadhayay was the top most leader of 'Platin Genesis'
company which deals with crypto-currency, which runs the scheme namely 'Plantin Coin'.
After the main accused informed her about the scheme, the complainant on her own invested the amount in crypto-currency.
The applicants have nothing to do with the scheme of crypto-currency.
According to him, at the most, the allegation against the applicants is of inducement to the complainant.

6. On perusal of the FIR, allegation of the complainant appears to be against the main accused along with the present applicants that they induced the complainant to invest the amount on assurance that she will get manifold benefits.

It appears that no amount has been handed over to the present applicants and the allegation against the present applicants is that they RR Jaiswal 3 48-aba-965-25.odt induced the complainant to invest the amount in the scheme.
Prima facie, it does not appear that the applicants are the beneficiaries of the said invested amount.
There is no criminal antecedents of applicant no. 1 and sofar as applicant no. 2 is concerned, there is no direct allegation of inducement against him.
7. The applicants are permanent residents of Nashik and there is no chance that they will flee from justice.
The applicants were protected by ad-interim order of this Court with a direction to attend the concerned Police Station and co-operate in the investigation.

Under the dictum of this Court,
they attended the Police Station and co-operated in the investigation.

8. Considering the nature of the complaint; nature of allegations against the present applicants; the role assigned to them and the punishment prescribed for the crime, the application deserves to be allowed.

Hence, the following order:-
 i) The application is allowed.

ii) The ad-interim protection granted to t applicants vide order dated 22.12.2025 is hereby confirmed on same terms and conditions except condition (iv).
iii) The applicants shall attend the concerned Police Station as and when directed by the Investigating Officer.
(M. W. CHA Signed by: Mr. Rajnesh Jaiswal  RRToJaiswal Designation: PA Honourable Judge Date: 06/03/2026 18:14:59
